title: A love story beneath the pagoda
summary: In a famous version of the White Snake legend, Bai Suzhen, a snake spirit in human form, loves a man named Xu Xian and is imprisoned beneath Leifeng Pagoda. The place is real; the magical events belong to folklore. Knowing the tale adds another layer to the lake view: a landmark can hold an imagined love story as well as a history of its own.

sections.heading: One tale, many tellings
sections.text: The national heritage record identifies the White Snake tradition as folk literature, listed in 2006. It describes a story retold through opera, fiction, film and other arts, with Hangzhou and Zhenjiang as important places of transmission. These retellings are not a single fixed account. Their cultural importance is evidence of a living tradition, not proof that the supernatural events occurred.
